Separately, +212 by fix/search-worker-call-cancellation (defect 1, 3.20.2), based off the pre-refresh 1820 count: +27 for an additive optional `gate` param threaded through search/searchByVector/bm25Search, the ensureFtsIndex two-phase (fast-path-then-exclusive) rewrite, and the LORE_TEST_WORKER_HOOKS-gated __testHold/__testCounters/checkGateDeadline test surface; +135 in the 3.20.2 independent-review remediation (same branch, follow-up commit) — finding 1 (BLOCKING): cachedRead()'s single-flight promise redesigned as a reference-counted SearchFlight (own AbortController, refCount, per-caller buildOwnAbort() wrapper) so a caller's own signal/deadline rejects only that caller, and the shared native call is aborted only once every joined caller has individually given up. Merged total (1770 base + 212) verified against the actual post-merge file via `wc -l`, not summed blindly across the two branches' independent deltas. Then +14 by the 3.21 i2 sync-main merge (3.21 step 3(c)'s NullEmbeddingProvider no-op guards in store()/the batch path + listIds' optional includeHistory, additive and in regions disjoint from 3.20.2's changes); merged total verified via `wc -l`. Then +57 (1996->2053) by feat/3.23-d7-piece-vectors (D7a, storage layer only): a `pieceIndex: LancePieceIndex` field + `pieceVectorsIntent: boolean` (constructed unconditionally, reusing the same embeddingProvider instance as the canonical store — never a second LocalEmbeddingProvider), one-line best-effort hooks (upsertForRows/deleteForIds, each `.catch`-guarded and logged, never thrown) added to store(), storeBatch(), bulkAddPrebuiltRows(), bulkUpsertPrebuiltRows(), physicalDelete(), physicalDeleteMany(), tombstone() and close(), an initialize() block that opens/validates the derived piece index (best-effort, does not block canonical open on failure), and two new public delegators (searchPieces, pieceIndexStatus) for the out-of-scope retrieval-routing slice to build on. Off by default (`pieceVectorsIntent` defaults false via `opts?.pieceVectors ?? false`) — no behavioural change to any existing write path when the feature is not opted in. Verified via `wc -l`. Then +36 (2053->2089) by feat/3.23-d7-piece-vectors (D7b, retrieval routing), later corrected in place (see next entry) — D7a's stub `searchPieces(queryVector: number[], topK: number)` widened toward the real retrieval-routing seam, threading `VerbatimQueryFilter`/D2-E2 filter pushdown, `actorScopes ?? getCurrentActorScopes()` and a minimal `gate?.signal?.aborted` check (not the full cachedRead/writeGate/searchGate machinery, a deliberate scope call for this slice) down to `LancePieceIndex.searchPieces` — plus one new public getter, `pieceVectorsIntentOn()`, exposing this store's own construction-time-resolved intent (distinct from `pieceIndexStatus().valid`, needed because a sidecar can stay open+valid from a prior run after intent is later turned off — resolveSeedStore's routing gate needs both signals). Verified via `wc -l`. Then +9 (2089->2098), same branch, same-day fix: the first D7b pass had `searchPieces` take `query: string` and unconditionally call `embeddingProvider.embedQuery(query)`, which broke 8 of 9 D7a Section-C tests in test/d7-piece-index-unit.ts (`TypeError: text.startsWith is not a function`) because those tests call the store-level `searchPieces` directly with a pre-embedded `number[]` vector, not a string — a real regression against D7a's own contract, caught by actually running T1 rather than only typechecking. Fixed by widening the parameter to `query: string | number[]` and embedding only when given a string (`typeof query === 'string' ? await embedQuery(query) : query`), mirroring the `string | number[]` convention `SqlitePieceIndex.searchPieces` (D7a) already established on the SQLite engine side; production callers (`pieceAwareSearch`) still always pass the raw string, so behaviour there is unchanged, and T1 (both engines) now passes 17/17 under Node 22 (the worktree's required engine — an initial run under a stray Node 20 shell showed 9 unrelated better-sqlite3 NODE_MODULE_VERSION failures on the sqlite variant, not a real bug, resolved by `nvm use 22`). Verified via `wc -l`. Then +7 (2098->2105), same branch (D7c, migration/lifecycle slice): one new public accessor, `pieceIndexForMigration()`, returning this store's own already-constructed LancePieceIndex instance for the new `lore migrate piece-vectors` CLI (engines/pieces/pieceIndexBuild.ts) to reuse rather than re-deriving a second Lance connection — every other caller still goes through searchPieces()/pieceIndexStatus(). Verified via `wc -l`. Then +26 (2105->2131) by fix/d7-search-worker-pieces (3.24.1): D7 piece vectors never built under the search worker in parent-embeds mode (the child's stub provider threw on every piece embed, swallowed by the per-hook `.catch(log.warn)`). Adds an optional `deferPieceBuild` constructor opt (set only by the search-worker child in parent-embeds mode) passed through to LancePieceIndex; one `verifyCoverage(this.table)` call in initialize() so an empty/partial piece table behind a valid sidecar (the 3.24.0 on-disk state) reports not_built; and three thin public delegators the proxy forwards over IPC (takePendingPieceRows, upsertPrebuiltPieces, reportPieceBuildFailure). The seven `.catch`-guarded hooks lose their `.catch` (LancePieceIndex now records failures itself — markIncomplete + one log.error), a net -2. The logic lives in engines/pieces/ (pendingPieceQueue.ts, lancePieceIndex.ts, pieceLayout.ts buildPieceRecords); what remains here is the delegator surface the forwarded-method protocol requires on VerbatimStore. Verified via `wc -l`. Then +17 (2131->2148) by feat/node-delete-purge (3.27.0): the `purgeWithHistory(ids)` delegator (assertWritableRole + unsafe-id guard, one search-epoch bump, pieceIndex.deleteForIds) for nodeDelete({ purge:true }); the anchored row collection + delete lives in engines/verbatimPurgeRows.ts. Verified via `wc -l`. Then +6 (2148->2154) by feat/node-delete-many (3.27.0): the `getExistingIds(ids)` delegator (batched getById existence test for nodeDeleteMany's alias lookup); the query lives in engines/verbatimPurgeRows.ts. Verified via `wc -l`.
